name: Lake Skulker Moss
summary: Lake Skulker Moss is a biological reagent gathered from the amphibious threshadon beasts inhabiting the northern reaches of Lake Lordamere. It was identified by Apothecary Berard, before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, as a key organic component for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into brewing a New Plague.

sections.title: A Plague Reagent
sections.body: Harvested from the hides and shells of Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers on the Dawning Isles, this damp aquatic moss possesses properties prized by Forsaken alchemists. Before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard meticulously cataloged the flora and fauna of eastern Silverpine Forest, concluding in his journal that both Lake Skulker and Lake Creeper mosses could serve as stabilizing or reactive agents. After Berard became a mindless servant of Arugal, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village for Apothecary Renferrel, who instructed Forsaken champions to gather moss samples alongside a rare tumor from local Vile Fin murlocs, delivering them directly to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Lake Skulker Moss used for?
faq.answer: It is utilized by the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity as an organic base ingredient for concocting the New Plague, serving the goals of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where does this moss come from?
faq.answer: The moss is scraped from the bodies of Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers, aquatic beasts that inhabit the waters around the Dawning Isles in northeastern Lake Lordamere, off the coast of Silverpine Forest.

Apothecary Berard first identified its potential during his field research in Silverpine Forest. Although Arugal's curse left Berard a mindless servant, his surviving journal guided Apothecary Renferrel and Master Apothecary Faranell to continue his experiments.
Master Apothecary Faranell, the leader of the Royal Apothecary Society residing in the Apothecarium of the Undercity, requires the moss to advance his biological warfare projects.

angles.text: Every batch of harvested moss brings the Royal Apothecary Society one step closer to perfecting the New Plague, the Forsaken's greatest weapon against both the Scourge and the living.
